series.label: Words per message
series.description: Average words per message (message length balance).

series.label: Absolutist-word rate
series.description: Share of words from the 19-word absolutist list (Al-Mosaiwi & Johnstone), skipping words directly after not, almost or nearly. Descriptive only.

series.label: I-words
series.description: Share of words that are I, me, my, mine or myself. Descriptive only.

series.label: We-words
series.description: Share of words that are we, us, our, ours or ourselves. Descriptive only.

series.label: Episodes opened
series.description: Share of episodes this side opened (first message after a 20-minute gap).

series.label: Median reply time
series.description: Median seconds from the other side's last message to this side's first reply in the same episode. Approximate.

series.label: Follow-up turns
series.description: Share of this side's turns that follow their own previous turn with no reply in between.

series.label: Episodes opened 01:00-04:00
series.description: Count of episodes this side opened between 01:00 and 04:00 local time. Neutral count.

limitations: This is not a diagnosis, an assessment or a test, and it cannot detect any condition.
It describes patterns in one text conversation only, not who you or the other person are.
Text messages miss tone of voice, context, and everything said in person or on calls.
Word rates and reply times are descriptive counts with no normal range and no cutoffs.
Reply times are approximate: notifications, sleep and busy days all change them.
AI-scored items can be wrong; items whose two scoring runs disagreed were left out.
Quotes are short excerpts and can read differently out of context.
disclaimer: Experimental self-reflection, not a clinical or diagnostic tool
